messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> capacity_exhaustion-us-east-1 :pager: 
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT #78912 created, urgency: high, routed to eng-oncall

sam: acked on PD. seeing autoscaler failing to provision new nodes, queue backlog growing. anyone oncall can confirm?

jordan: i'm oncall. looking at autoscaler logs now. initial symptom: controller attempted scale +60 but cloud API returned 429/QuotaExceeded for new instances.

maria: i'm nearby. metrics: request queue length for inference-workers up to 48k, tail latency > 6s for high-priority routes, error rate 502s creeping to 1.8%.

lia: fwiw, we flipped the new compact-quant profile in us-east-1 yesterday which reduced per-host concurrency. suspicious.

sam: good catch. could be capacity per-gpu decreased so autoscaler needs more nodes than before. check node type mix and quotas.

jordan: checking node pools: gpu-pool-a at 80% CPU, quota for region (gpus) remaining = 0 (reported by cloud). autoscaler kept retrying but cloud returns 403/Quota. stacktrace snippet: ```2026-03-15T15:12:02Z scale-controller: reconcile failed: CreateInstances: quotaExceeded```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggestion 
1) escalate to cloud-quotas team if short term fix needed
2) manual capacity bypass: request temporary burst nodes (spot->on-demand)
3) reroute non-prod traffic to fallback region
4) throttle low-priority customers via rate-limiter

maria: applying runbook step 2: requesting temporary node quota bump via cloud console now. submitting request (ticket #CLOUD-3456).

sam: in parallel, can we throttle or disable background batch jobs to free capacity? which routes are safe to deprioritize?

lia: background reranks and nightly embedding jobs are heavy. pausing them frees ~20% capacity. issuing pause now.

jordan: paused background jobs. queue drain rate improved slightly. still stuck because new pods not created.

sre-shift: starting manual scale alternative: create additional inference replicas using smaller model_variant (quantized-v2) that fits into existing GPU quota. deploying canary to route 10% traffic.

sam: good. command I ran: ```kubectl -n inference scale deploy model-inference --replicas=40 --image=model-quantized-v2:stable``` only allowed within current quota. verifying shard mapping...

jordan: canary started. routing config updated: 10% -> quantized-v2, 90% -> primary. early telemetry: tail latency for canary 120ms, primary still 5-6s. errors for primary remain high.

maria: customer-impact note: two enterprise customers (accts: omni-pay, dataflow.ai) reported elevated latencies and some timeouts. CS ticketing shows increased chats. We should notify account teams.

sam: @lia please draft quick customer message. mention degraded latency in us-east, mitigations in progress, expected stabilization window 30-60min.

lia: pinging growth/support: "Heads up — us-east inference degraded, partial fallback to quantized-v2. We're throttling non-critical jobs and requesting cloud quota. We'll update in 30 min." :warning:

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT #78912 status -> acknowledged by jordan. escalation scheduled in 10 minutes if unacknowledged.

jordan: cloud quota request approved (CLOUD-3456) but provisioning will take ~12 minutes to reflect. suggest increasing autoscaler retry backoff to avoid hammering cloud API.

sam: changing controller backoff: ```./scripts/patch-scale-controller --region us-east --backoff-ms 60000``` applying now.

ops-runbook-bot: Temporary mitigation checklist updated in thread.

maria: new nodes are initializing. kube events: ```Normal Pulling, Normal Created, Normal Started``` pods scheduling.

jordan: new nodes ready, autoscaler reconciled, we see worker count +24. queue length falling: 48k -> 18k in 7m. tail latency trending down.

sam: great. running targeted rollout to restore full traffic off canary. will gradually re-route 15% increments.

lia: customer message updated: "Stability improving. We’re restoring normal routing gradually; expect full recovery in ~15–20 minutes. We’ll follow with incident summary." :white_check_mark:

sre-shift: monitoring for error regressions and flapping. setting alert suppression for duplicate capacity alerts for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT #78912 status -> resolved by jordan. resolution note: cloud quota bump + temporary canary routing + paused background jobs.

maria: post-incident actions: 1) add autoscaler-aware change guideline for quantized profiles 2) request permanent quota increase for us-east 3) add an early-warning metric for queue growth vs quota remaining 4) postmortem owner = jordan

sam: agree. I'll create the postmortem doc and link here. tagging @sre-shift for followups.

jordan: creating postmortem draft: /docs/incidents/78912-autoscaler-quotabump.md (draft) — will include timeline, mitigation, RCA and action items.

lia: closing notes: no data loss, customer impact limited to higher latency + transient timeouts for some requests. follow-ups scheduled in ops sync tomorrow. :calendar:
